diagnosis: The route checks that the user holds the internal auditor role, but fails to enforce departmental or division scoping on the queried expense. An auditor assigned exclusively to retail division audits can inspect executive compensation and confidential R&D project expenditures.
exploit_request:
GET /auditing/audit/expenses/4491 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <retail_auditor_jwt>
